messages:
alyssa: Escalation from Acme Security — they're seeing gaps in audit events (write entries not appearing) across eu-west and us-central after yesterday's infra patch. They say this affects their compliance report due EOD tomorrow.
acme_engineer: Hi team, attaching logs they sent. We get a 503 on the audit ingest endpoint intermittently and then the event never shows up in the audit index. Sample trace: 
```
  2026-03-16T14:12:03Z WARN audit_ingest failed to ack event id=abc123 status=503
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit -d '{"event":"login"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -v
```
alyssa: Customer asked for ETA on a patch and any signed attestation they can include in their audit. They also asked for mitigation steps they can take now.
ryan: Looking. Could be related to the libssl/libcrypto update we pushed yesterday (pkg: openssl 3.2.1). Priya, any active CVE tie-ins? :eyes:
priya: We've correlated to CVE-2026-0147 (hypothetical integrity bug in openssl consumer codepaths) — vendor released mitigations but some consumers need to rotate key wrapping configs. We need to confirm whether our keystore client hits the vulnerable code path when rolling TLS sessions during audit flushes.
carlos: Customer wants a clear timeline and proof. What's realistic for a hotfix + signed attestation?
priya: Proposal: immediate mitigations + hotfix plan:
- Mitigate (now): flip audit ingestion to use direct HSM-backed signing (bypass openssl wrapper) and enable synchronous flush for audit writes for affected tenants. This is a config flip, can be done in <1h per region.
- Hotfix (48–72h): backport restricted patch to our runtime and deploy canary to 5% traffic -> 100% in staging -> global, with signed build artifacts and attestations.
ryan: Repro steps for SRE/eng:
```
# reproduce 503 on audit endpoint
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit?region=eu-west" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"event":"test-audit","payload":"x"}' -v
# then query audit index
curl -s "https://console.redwood.example/api/audit/index?event_id=abc123"
```
emily: I'll schedule a sync with the customer at T+1h to offer immediate mitigations. They asked explicitly for a signed attestation PDF and a patch ETA in writing. Can we commit to 72h and provide daily progress updates?
priya: Yes — commit: 48h for canary + signed artifact for the canary build, 72h for global rollout if canary is clean. I'll prepare an attestation template stating we discovered an integrity regression related to CVE-2026-0147, actions taken, and the build hashes.
ryan: Ops steps to flip mitigation (runbook):
1) set flag: `audit.ingest.path=HSM_DIRECT` via control-plane API
2) set `audit.flush.sync=true` for tenant acme-corp
3) monitor `/metrics/audit_ingest_errors` -> target <1/min
API snippet:
```
PATCH /api/v1/tenants/acme-corp/config
{ "audit": { "ingest_path": "HSM_DIRECT", "flush_sync": true } }
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy of rtx-runtime@2026.3.17-patch-0147 scheduled to eu-west-1 in 30m (author: priya).
acme_engineer: Appreciate the quick plan. Two asks: (1) a signed PDF attestation we can deliver to audit team, (2) confirmation you won't revoke logs retroactively (we need proof of non-repudiation).
priya: We'll provide the attestation and a signed merkle proof for events we can still find. We will not alter historical logs; we'll provide signed export where available.
carlos: I'll own customer comms and coordinate the attestation file and the legal signoff. Emily will send customer-facing note in 1h.
emily: Confirmed. I'll mention the 48/72h timeline and the immediate config mitigation. I'll also ask them to run the curl repro we provided and share traces. :pray:
alyssa: Thanks all — I'm creating an incident ticket (INC-2026-0821) and will keep thread updated.
priya: I'll open the patch PR and post the artifact hash here when ready.
ryan: I'll stand by for the mitigation flips and metrics watch.
acme_engineer: Thanks, team. We'll test the mitigation once you flip it and report back in the channel.
